reason: B offers a clearer, directly testable intervention targeting interfacial thermal resistance, with a controlled comparison and proof-of-principle evidence for increased contact area reducing TBR. Its extrapolation from GaN/diamond to an HEA reactor interface and its conflation of reduced TBR with increased effective conductivity are weaknesses, but A relies on unsupported W-rich precipitation and assumes such precipitates would improve conductivity despite alloy-scattering and phase-stability concerns.
